searchText: Mind you that we're getting rid of "PostState" here https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/3512 as it was a lot of overhead to think about, so new api will be simpler revm does checks on state/ nonce/balance as so we dont need to do it twice somewhere else In the lingo of eth client devs, does consensus algorithm refer to the forkchoice algo usually? so POW is really heaviest chain choice + certain validity rules for the blockchain tree itself right? Calling POW a consensus algo is a little inaccurate to my understanding? PoW is just the sybil resistance mech, the forkchoice & the process by which you agree on the forkchoice is what defines the consensus, you can do PoS heaviest chain (which is part of Ethereum's consensus also)
